scriptText:
I. PART I

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic, sun-drenched ensemble drama scene set at the Cabo da Roca cliffside overlook in Portugal, featuring @actor1 as EVAN, @actor2 as FELIX, @actor3 as SAMIRA, and @actor4 as ROSA engaging in energetic, overlapping nostalgic banter.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Ensure spatial continuity across the four platform areas, strict eye line discipline between opposing characters, stable wardrobe condition, constant ocean wind direction blowing hair and loose fabric toward the east, and seamless match-on-action transitions between camera setups.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm film grain, natural direct sunlight, warm coastal color grade.
Palette: Sun-bleached concrete grey, Atlantic ocean navy, mustard yellow, terracotta rust, sand beige.
Lighting: High afternoon sun, bright ocean reflections, strong side contrast.
Location: Elevated stone platform at Cabo da Roca, granite cliffs, ocean horizon.
Wardrobe: Evan in charcoal denim shirt over white tee; Felix in cream cardigan and wire glasses; Samira in terracotta linen shirt; Rosa in mustard blazer over black tank top with gold chains.
Props: Weathered wooden tour pamphlet on bench, small granite pebbles on concrete deck, vintage watch on Evan's left wrist.
Sound: Diegetic ocean waves crashing below, rhythmic coastal wind gusts, footfalls on concrete.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
[CAM 01] A sunlit wide establishing composition of the Cabo da Roca overlook deck facing north toward the open ocean. Evan stands near the center-north back, leaning his lower back against the dark northern timber railing over the cliff edge. Rosa stands near the western vertical timber post on frame-left. Felix sits upright on the long central concrete bench on frame-right. Samira leans her shoulder against the textured eastern concrete windbreak wall on far frame-right. The ocean wind whips through their garments, establishing all four positions across the concrete platform.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] EWS, HIGH ANGLE, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Evan at northern timber railing, Rosa at western timber post, Felix on central concrete bench, Samira at eastern concrete wall -> [ACT] Ocean wind whips Rosa's yellow-highlighted hair as she turns toward Evan -> Rosa says (exasperated laugh) {—and I told him!} -> [ACT] Rosa takes a sharp step across the concrete floor toward the center -> <Footstep slap on concrete>
[CAM 03] MS, EYE LEVEL, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Rosa center-left, western timber post in background -> [ACT] Rosa grabs the lapels of her mustard yellow blazer, her gold chains swinging in the wind -> Rosa says (loud scoff) {I literally grabbed his collar and said—} -> [ACT] Rosa jabs her index finger into the air toward frame-right -> <Chains clinking>
[CAM 02] MS, LOW ANGLE, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Evan leaning back against northern timber railing, ocean horizon behind -> [ACT] Evan tilts his head back against the ocean breeze, wheezing with laughter -> Rosa says O.S. {‘Evan, that is a one-way street.’} -> [ACT] Evan grips the timber rail tightly behind his back, his shoulders shaking
[CAM 04] MS, EYE LEVEL, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Felix seated on concrete bench, Samira visible leaning against eastern concrete wall behind him -> [ACT] Felix shifts his weight on the bench, leaning his elbows onto his knees -> Felix says (gentle sigh) {In fairness, Rosa...} -> [ACT] Felix reaches up with his hand to adjust the bridge of his wire-rim glasses
[CAM 04] -> [BLOCK] Felix seated on concrete bench, adjusting glasses -> [ACT] Sunlight glints off Felix's round lenses as he lowers his hand -> Felix says {...the sign was completely rusted off the post.} -> [ACT] Felix shakes his head softly with a quiet chuckle -> <Ocean breeze whistling>
[CAM 04] -> [BLOCK] Felix seated on concrete bench frame-left, Samira slouched against eastern concrete wall frame-right -> [ACT] Felix tilts his head toward Rosa off-camera -> Felix says {You couldn't read it.} -> [ACT] Felix rests his hands calmly on his knees
[CAM 05] MCU, EYE LEVEL, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Samira leaning her shoulder against textured grey concrete wall, arms folded -> [ACT] Samira remains motionless, dark eyes staring coolly toward frame-left -> Samira says (dry monotone) {It wasn't rusted.} -> [ACT] Samira shifts her posture slightly against the concrete surface
[CAM 05] -> [ACT] Samira tilts her head slightly, her silver signet ring catching the sunlight -> Samira says (deadpan delivery) {It was in Portuguese.} -> [ACT] Samira blinks slowly without changing her cold expression
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan against northern timber railing, facing south toward Samira -> [ACT] Evan drops his head forward, letting out a sharp snort of laughter -> Evan says (wheezing snort) {Thank you, Samira.} -> [ACT] Evan rubs his forehead with his left wrist, watch visible
[CAM 02] -> [ACT] Evan uses his right thumb to wipe a tear of laughter from the corner of his eye -> Evan says (grinning wheeze) {Really appreciate the loyalty here.} -> [ACT] Evan pushes off slightly from the timber railing, still grinning
[CAM 03] -> [BLOCK] Rosa center-left, timber post behind her -> [ACT] Rosa throws both hands into the air in disbelief, turning toward Felix -> Rosa says (indignant gasp) {Portuguese or rusted—} -> [ACT] Rosa stomps her leather boot hard against the deck -> <Heavy boot thump on concrete>
[CAM 01] -> [BLOCK] All four characters visible across deck; Evan at northern rail, Rosa near western post, Felix on bench, Samira at eastern wall -> [ACT] Rosa paces a short distance toward Evan, pointing aggressively -> Rosa says (loud banter) {—he drove us right into a ditch!} -> [ACT] Evan leans back against the timber railing again, chuckling -> <Wind gust flapping cloth>
[CAM 03] -> [BLOCK] Rosa facing frame-right toward Evan -> [ACT] Rosa crosses her arms tightly over her mustard blazer -> Rosa says {We sat in that car for three hours...} -> [ACT] Rosa shakes her head with a dramatic sigh
[CAM 03] -> [ACT] Rosa points accusingly at Evan -> Rosa says {—because Mr. Shortcut over here couldn't wait for the rain to clear!} -> [ACT] Rosa turns her head back toward Felix on the bench
[CAM 04] -> [BLOCK] Felix on concrete bench frame-center, Samira visible on concrete wall background -> [ACT] Felix lets out a soft humming laugh, leaning back on the bench -> Felix says (warm smile) {Hey. We got out, didn't we?} -> [ACT] Felix turns his gaze upward toward Evan at the northern timber rail
[CAM 05] -> [BLOCK] Samira leaning against eastern concrete wall -> [ACT] Samira looks down at her shoe, flicking a small granite pebble across the concrete deck -> Samira says O.S. (quiet deadpan) {Barely.} -> [ACT] The small pebble rolls across the deck floor while ocean wind whistles through the concrete gap -> <Pebble skittering on concrete>
[</BRIEF>]

II. PART II

[[STAGING]]
[[GOAL]]
Create a cinematic continuation from @video1 featuring @actor1 as EVAN, @actor2 as FELIX, @actor3 as SAMIRA, and @actor4 as ROSA.
[[/GOAL]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Maintain strict spatial, visual, and performance continuity inherited directly from @video1 across all camera setups. Preserve exact character placement on the concrete platform, dark denim and sweater wardrobe details, afternoon sun angle, and constant ocean wind vectors blowing hair and clothing toward the east. Ensure match-on-action transitions and steady eye-line alignment across opposing character setups.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Sound: Diegetic coastal wind gusts, ocean waves crashing against rocks below, boot steps on concrete, fabric rustling. No background music.
Wardrobe: Evan in charcoal denim shirt over white tee; Felix in cream cardigan and wire glasses; Samira in terracotta linen shirt; Rosa in mustard blazer over black tank top with gold chains.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MS, low angle shot focusing on Samira's dark leather boots beside the textured eastern concrete wall, where a small granite pebble comes to rest on the sunlit concrete deck floor while ocean wind sweeps across the platform.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 02] MS, LOW ANGLE, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Evan at northern timber railing -> [ACT] Evan pushes his lower back off the wooden railing, stepping into the center of the concrete platform while adjusting the lapels of his open dark denim shirt -> Evan says (playful clear throat) {Okay, look—} -> [ACT] Evan raises both hands with open palms in a mock surrender gesture -> <Fabric rustling in wind>
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan center deck, palms raised -> [ACT] Evan shrugs defensively, keeping his posture light -> Evan says {—miscalculation on the turn? Yes.} -> [ACT] Evan lowers his left hand while keeping his right hand gesturing in the air -> <Ocean breeze whistling>
[CAM 01] EWS, HIGH ANGLE, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Evan center deck, Rosa near western timber post, Felix on concrete bench, Samira at eastern concrete wall -> [ACT] Evan points his right index finger toward his own chest, looking between Felix and Rosa -> Evan says {But who found the gas station?} -> [ACT] Evan gestures broadly with both arms open toward the group -> <Footsteps on concrete deck>
[CAM 01] -> [BLOCK] All four characters visible across deck -> [ACT] Evan turns slightly toward Rosa -> Evan says {Who bought the terrible coffee at three in the morning?} -> [ACT] Rosa crosses her arms tightly over her mustard yellow blazer, a sly smirk forming as she turns toward him -> <Wind rustling clothing>
[CAM 03] MS, EYE LEVEL, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Rosa near western timber post -> [ACT] Rosa takes a few steps directly into Evan's personal space, her eyes fixed on his face -> Rosa says (sly smirk) {Felix bought the coffee.} -> [ACT] Rosa tilts her chin up, inspecting Evan closely -> <Leather boots stepping on concrete>
[CAM 03] -> [BLOCK] Rosa standing close in front of Evan -> [ACT] Rosa shifts her weight on the deck, holding her posture -> Rosa says {You were sitting on the hood... complaining about your knees.} -> [ACT] Rosa holds her smug smile, waiting for his reaction -> <Wind flapping clothing>
[CAM 04] MS, EYE LEVEL, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Felix seated on concrete bench, Samira visible leaning against eastern concrete wall behind him -> [ACT] Felix nods slowly, making a quiet grimace as he recalls the taste -> Felix says (quiet chuckling sigh) {It was terrible coffee. Tasted like burnt gravel.} -> [ACT] Felix swallows hard and rubs his chin thoughtfully
[CAM 04] -> [BLOCK] Felix on bench frame-left, Samira leaning against concrete wall frame-right -> [ACT] Felix watches Evan off-camera while Samira uncrosses her arms -> Evan says O.S. (defensive laugh) {I was twenty-four! My knees were fine!} -> [ACT] Samira's lips curve upward into a subtle, faint smile -> <Ocean waves crashing below>
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan standing in center platform -> [ACT] Evan taps his right knee firmly through his denim jeans, chuckling defensively -> Evan says {My knees were fine!} -> [ACT] Evan lowers his hand back to his side as Rosa steps closer into the foreground
[CAM 03] -> [BLOCK] Rosa standing directly in front of Evan -> [ACT] Rosa leans forward slightly under the bright sunlight, squinting at his face -> Rosa says {Yeah, well... look at you now.} -> [ACT] Rosa raises her right hand, hovering a finger near the side of Evan's head -> <Gold chain clinking>
[CAM 03] -> [BLOCK] Rosa hovering her finger near Evan's temple -> [ACT] Rosa gestures subtly toward his hairline before dropping her arm -> Rosa says (playful tease) {You’ve got grey hair coming in at the temples, old man.} -> [ACT] Evan freezes in place, his playful grin faltering slightly -> <Wind gust sweeping past>
[CAM 05] MS, EYE LEVEL, LOCKOFF -> [BLOCK] Samira leaning her shoulder against eastern concrete wall -> [ACT] Samira uncrosses her arms, letting them hang casually at her sides -> Samira says (dry tone) {It’s true. You’re looking weathered, Evan.} -> [ACT] Samira rests her shoulders back against the smooth concrete surface
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan standing in center deck -> [ACT] Evan slowly lifts his right hand, touching his fingers against the dark hair over his right temple -> Evan says (softened laugh) {Yeah. Well...} -> [ACT] Evan lowers his hand and drops his gaze toward his scuffed boots on the concrete floor
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan looking down at his boots -> [ACT] Evan exhales a long, quiet breath as his expression shifts to quiet reflection -> Evan says (quiet tone) {...three years will do that to a guy.} -> [ACT] Evan stands motionless as the coastal wind rustles his dark denim shirt -> <Wind whistling across concrete deck>
[CAM 04] -> [BLOCK] Felix seated on concrete bench frame-left, Samira behind frame-right -> [ACT] Felix leans forward slightly on the bench, resting his forearms on his knees with gentle sincerity -> Felix says (warm soft voice) {You wear it okay.} -> [ACT] Felix offers a quiet, reassuring nod while a peaceful silence falls over the sunlit platform -> <Ocean ambience fading into quiet swell>
[</BRIEF>]

III. PART III

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic, emotional scene continuation from @video1 featuring @actor1 as EVAN, @actor2 as FELIX, @actor3as SAMIRA, and @actor4 as ROSA, as Evan turns to face the ocean horizon and shares a heartfelt moment of raw gratitude with his friends at Cabo da Roca.
[[/INTENT]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Maintain strict spatial, visual, and performance continuity inherited directly from @video1 across all camera setups. Preserve exact character placement on the concrete platform, dark denim shirt, beige cardigan, mustard blazer, and rust blouse wardrobe details, afternoon sun angle, and constant ocean wind vectors blowing hair and clothing toward the east. Ensure match-on-action transitions and steady eye-line alignment across opposing character setups.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: Diegetic coastal wind gusts, ocean waves crashing against rocks below, boot steps on concrete, fabric rustling. No background music.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MS, eye level lockoff frame inheriting the final frame of @video1, showing Felix seated on a concrete bench frame-left looking up with a soft reassuring smile, while Samira stands leaning against a raw concrete wall frame-right under warm late-afternoon sun with the ocean horizon glistening in the background.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 02] MS, LOW ANGLE -> [BLOCK] Evan standing center platform -> [ACT] Evan turns away from Rosa, walking back toward the northern timber railing while ocean wind rustles his dark denim shirt -> [ACT] Evan rests both forearms flat against the worn wooden rail, staring down at the crashing white sea foam -> <Wind gust sweeping across wood>
[CAM 02] -> [STATE IN] Evan facing away, forearms on railing -> [ACT] Evan grips the wooden rail firmly with both hands -> Evan says (quiet raspy voice) {I kept thinking about that night...} -> [ACT] Evan exhales a long breath through his nose, his shoulders dropping slightly -> <Ocean waves roaring below>
[CAM 04] MS, EYE LEVEL -> [BLOCK] Felix seated on concrete bench frame-left, Samira standing against concrete wall frame-right -> [ACT] Felix shifts forward on the bench, resting his forearms on his knees while listening attentively (eye focus on frame-left) -> Evan says O.S. (heavy breath) {...on the drive up here today.} -> [ACT] Felix tilts his head slightly with gentle warmth -> Felix says (soft whisper) {Yeah?}
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan at timber railing frame-center -> [ACT] Evan keeps his gaze locked on the horizon, his fingers squeezing tighter against the wooden rail -> Evan says (vulnerable swallow) {I kept thinking... if you guys had not stayed in the car...} -> [ACT] Evan blinks against the harsh sunlight, his jaw tightening -> <Fabric rustling in wind>
[CAM 02] -> [STATE IN] Evan gripping wooden rail -> [ACT] Evan lowers his head slightly, watching the waves -> Evan says (cracking voice) {...if you had not kept talking to me...} -> [ACT] Evan shakes his head slowly from side to side -> <Wind whistling over railing>
[CAM 01] EWS, HIGH ANGLE -> [BLOCK] Wide perspective showing Evan at northern railing, Rosa near western timber post, Felix on central bench, Samira by eastern wall -> [ACT] Evan remains leaning over the railing while the three friends watch him in motionless silence -> Evan says O.S. (raw emotion) {I do not think I ever would have pulled out of that ditch.} -> [ACT] Rosa lowers her folded arms to her sides, stepping slightly forward on the concrete floor -> <Ocean swell crashing against cliffs>
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan frame-center at railing -> [ACT] Evan lifts his head slightly, staring into the bright distant ocean horizon -> Evan says (quiet sigh) {I would have just sat there... and let the storm take it.} -> [ACT] Evan closes his eyes briefly, inhaling the salty sea breeze -> <Wind howling over cliffside>
[CAM 05] MCU, EYE LEVEL -> [BLOCK] Samira leaning her back against the raw concrete wall -> [ACT] Samira tightens her jaw, her dark eyes locking onto Evan off-camera with solemn focus -> Evan says O.S. (deep gratitude) {You did not let me quit.} -> [ACT] Samira remains entirely still, her hair fluttering across her face in the breeze -> <Ocean spray ambience>
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan at timber railing -> [ACT] Evan turns his head over his left shoulder toward the group, his eyes glistening with tears -> Evan says (soft emotional chuckle) {None of you did... even when I wanted to.} -> [ACT] Evan touches his right hand to his chest before dropping it back down -> <Quiet wind swell>
[CAM 03] MS, EYE LEVEL -> [BLOCK] Rosa standing near western timber post frame-left, Evan visible in background frame-right -> [ACT] Rosa gazes back at Evan, her expression softening into deep empathy -> Evan says O.S. (gentle smile) {We actually made it to here, Rosa.} -> [ACT] Rosa lets out a soft, breathless smile, nodding quietly -> <Wind rustling blazer fabric>
[CAM 02] -> [BLOCK] Evan standing at railing turned toward camera -> [ACT] Evan lets out a soft, tearful laugh, his dimples showing as sunlight catches his wet eyes -> Evan says (chuckle through tears) {Exactly where we promised we would go.} -> [ACT] Evan nods to himself, a warm smile breaking across his face -> <Ocean breeze blowing shirt lapels>
[CAM 01] -> [BLOCK] All four characters positioned across the sunlit concrete deck with the vast Atlantic ocean beyond -> [ACT] Evan turns fully back toward his friends, spreading his hands gently at his sides -> Evan says O.S. (quiet warmth) {Three years late... but we made it.} -> [ACT] Felix, Rosa, and Samira stand in peaceful togetherness as the golden afternoon light bathes the cliffside lookout -> <Ocean waves roaring steadily into quiet swell>
[</BRIEF>]

IV. PART IV

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic, emotionally devastating scene continuation from @video1 featuring @actor1 as EVAN, @actor2 as FELIX, @actor3as SAMIRA, and @actor4 as ROSA at the cliffside overlook of Cabo da Roca, as Evan realizes his friends are not truly there and accepts his solitary reality on his birthday.
[[/INTENT]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Maintain strict spatial, visual, and performance continuity inherited directly @video1 across all camera setups. Preserve exact character placement on the concrete platform, dark denim shirt over white tee wardrobe, beige cardigan, mustard blazer, and terracotta shirt details, afternoon sun angle, and constant ocean wind vectors blowing hair and clothing toward the east. Ensure match-on-action transitions and steady eyeline alignment across opposing character setups.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: Diegetic coastal wind gusts, ocean waves crashing against cliff rocks below, boot steps on concrete, fabric rustling. No background music.
Wardrobe: Evan in charcoal denim shirt over white tee; Felix in cream cardigan and wire glasses; Samira in terracotta linen shirt; Rosa in mustard blazer over black tank top with gold chains.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
EWS, high angle lockoff frame inheriting the final frame of @video1, showing Evan standing center platform facing his three friends (Felix seated on a central concrete bench, Rosa near a wooden railing post frame-left, and Samira leaning against a raw concrete wall frame-right) under warm golden sunlight with the vast ocean glistening in the background.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] EWS, HIGH ANGLE -> [STATE IN] All four figures positioned across sunlit concrete deck -> [ACT] Evan stands facing his friends with arms spread gently and a lingering dimpled smile, waiting in hopeful silence -> Evan says (soft chuckle) -> [ACT] Evan stays in position with open arms while waiting for a response -> <Coastal wind gust blowing shirt lapels>
[START AT 00:01] [CAM 02] MS, EYE LEVEL -> [STATE IN] Evan facing camera with a fading warm smile -> [ACT] Evan lowers his arms back to his sides, tilting his head slightly in expectation -> Evan says (expectant sigh) {Come on, Rosa.} -> [ACT] Evan keeps his eyes locked forward as his smile slowly begins to falter -> <Ocean waves roaring below>
[CAM 03] MS, EYE LEVEL -> [STATE IN] Rosa standing motionless in her mustard blazer near the timber post -> [ACT] Rosa stays completely still without speaking, hair fluttering across her face -> Evan says O.S. (hesitant tone) {No commentary?} -> [ACT] Rosa remains silent, eyes fixed in a distant unblinking gaze -> <Wind whistling over timber rail>
[CAM 02] -> [STATE IN] Evan standing frame-center with faltering expression -> [ACT] Evan shifts his posture slightly, furrowing his brow in growing confusion -> Evan says (nervous laugh) {You are not gonna tell me I am being emotional?} -> [ACT] Evan glances toward frame-right, searching their faces -> <Fabric rustling in wind>
[CAM 04] MS, EYE LEVEL -> [STATE IN] Felix seated on concrete bench frame-left, Samira leaning on wall frame-right -> [ACT] Felix remains frozen on the bench with a subtle smile, not making eye contact -> Evan says O.S. (soft strain) {Felix?} -> [ACT] Samira stands silent against the concrete wall, her posture entirely motionless -> <Waves crashing against cliff rocks>
[CAM 05] MCU, EYE LEVEL -> [STATE IN] Samira leaning back against the raw concrete wall -> [ACT] Samira remains motionless as wind blows dark curls across her face -> Evan says O.S. (cracking whisper) {Samira?} -> [ACT] Samira offers no response, her unblinking gaze staring past the camera into space -> <Wind whistling against wall>
[CAM 02] -> [STATE IN] Evan standing isolated frame-center, head tilted -> [ACT] Evan slowly lowers his eyes, staring down at his scuffed leather boots on the grey concrete floor -> [ACT] Evan exhales a heavy, trembling breath through his nose as a deep crease forms on his forehead -> <Heavy ocean spray rumble>
[CAM 04] -> [STATE IN] Concrete bench frame-left and concrete wall section frame-right -> [ACT] Sunlight shines across the completely empty cast-concrete bench and deserted wall with no people present -> [ACT] Dust particles drift across the bare, sunlit concrete deck -> <Wind whistling along empty wall>
[CAM 03] -> [STATE IN] Western timber railing post -> [ACT] The wooden railing post stands entirely solitary against the vast ocean backdrop, with no one present -> [ACT] Ocean breeze sweeps over the deserted wooden rail -> <Ocean swell crashing below>
[CAM 01] -> [STATE IN] Entire sunlit concrete lookout platform -> [ACT] Evan stands completely alone in the center of the broad deck, looking around at the empty platform -> [ACT] Evan blinks slowly as the continuous ocean wind whips his dark denim shirt -> <Roar of sea waves breaking on rocks below>
[CAM 02] MCU, EYE LEVEL -> [STATE IN] Evan standing alone frame-center -> [ACT] Evan raises his left arm, pulling back his dark denim sleeve with his right hand -> [ACT] Evan stares down at his digital wrist watch face, displaying the text OCTOBER 14 -> <Leather watch strap creaking>
[CAM 02] -> [STATE IN] Evan staring at his wrist watch -> [ACT] Evan drops his left arm back to his side and swallows hard, his jaw tightening -> [ACT] Evan slowly turns his body around toward the ocean horizon, walking forward to grip the wooden cliffside railing with both hands -> Evan says (cracked whisper) {...Happy birthday to me.} -> [ACT] Evan nods once to the sea in silent acceptance as wind sweeps over his face -> <Ocean wind gust blowing shirt lapels>
[CAM 02] -> [STATE IN] Evan facing ocean, standing still -> [ACT] Evan stand still -> [CAM] Slowly pull out -> [ACT] Evan accept the silence as wind sweeps over his clothes and hair while facing the ocean -> <Ocean wind gust blowing shirt lapels> -> [CAM] Pull out to WS.
[</BRIEF>]
